purpose: Which aggregation policies exist, which evaluator versions were meant to apply them, and which of those combinations a formal result may be attributed to. A policy file alone cannot say this: it does not know what code read it.

statuses.active: the combination a run selects by default; formal results allowed
statuses.superseded: retired by a later version; kept byte-identical for the record
statuses.record_only: kept so that anything recorded under it stays interpretable. No formal result was ever produced under it, and none may be

safe_sum_v1.note: superseded before any run reached it

safe_sum_v2.note: superseded before any run reached it

safe_sum_v3.note: four release paths found in review; see why_v4
